pr_title: cli: fix two issues with `cockroach dump` and comments
pr_body:
Fixes #51115.

Release note (bug fix): Fix a bug where `cockroach dump` would not
properly escape quotes within table comments.

Release note (bug fix); Fix a bug where `cockroach dump` would not emit
a correct statement for comments on indexes.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/51436)
May I suggest you change the code inside that function to use a `tree.FmtCtx` like the other functions in the same file, and follow the pattern to print names.

issue_context.title: sql: SHOW CREATE TABLE does not escape quotes in comments
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

```
root@:26257/defaultdb> create table foo(id integer);
CREATE TABLE

Time: 3.301744ms

root@:26257/defaultdb> comment on table foo is 'name '' here';
COMMENT ON TABLE

Time: 3.519957ms

root@:26257/defaultdb> ^D
don@cube[ca-1]:iomad$ cockroach dump --insecure defaultdb
CREATE TABLE foo (
	id INT8 NULL,
	FAMILY "primary" (id, rowid)
);
COMMENT ON TABLE foo IS 'name ' here';
```

the unescaped single quote in the comment will not reload.

This can be traced back to the fact that the introspection-generated CREATE statement doesn't have it escaped:
```
root@127.0.0.1:63147/movr> create table foo(id integer);
CREATE TABLE

Time: 3.355ms

root@127.0.0.1:63147/movr> comment on table foo is 'name '' here';
COMMENT ON TABLE

Time: 3.824ms

root@127.0.0.1:63147/movr> show create table foo;
  table_name |           create_statement
-------------+----------------------------------------
  foo        | CREATE TABLE foo (
             |     id INT8 NULL,
             |     FAMILY "primary" (id, rowid)
             | );
             | COMMENT ON TABLE foo IS 'name ' here'
(1 row)

Time: 6.437ms
```


**Expected behavior**

`SHOW CREATE TABLE` output should be parsable. `cockroach dump` output should be able to be loaded.


**Environment:**

```
cockroach version
Build Tag:    v20.1.0
Build Time:   2020/05/05 00:07:18
Distribution: CCL
Platform:     linux amd64 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
Go Version:   go1.13.9
C Compiler:   gcc 6.3.0
Build SHA-1:  9d456b9ec82cbf9a740a092c0d9f56da48779689
Build Type:   release
```
